title: Azure AI Foundry workspace service
description: Use an approved model with configurable network access and authentication. The parent workspace must use Automatic authentication with Entra groups enabled.

display_name.title: Name for the workspace service
display_name.description: Enter the workspace service name displayed to users.

description.title: Description of the workspace service
description.description: Enter a short workspace service description.
description.default: Use an approved AI model from the workspace network.

overview.title: Workspace service overview
overview.description: Enter a detailed workspace service overview in Markdown.
overview.default:
Use the approved model through the OpenAI chat completions API. Private network access and Microsoft Entra ID authentication are the defaults. You can enable public network access and API key authentication independently. The service outputs provide the endpoint, deployment name and Key Vault secret URI when keys are enabled. Owners and researchers receive Cognitive Services OpenAI User at this account only. This built-in role permits more than chat completions, including Assistants and Responses operations. API keys bypass per-user Entra role checks.

Create the parent workspace with `auth_type=Automatic` and `create_aad_groups=true`. Workspace owners manage the service through TRE. When keys are enabled, owners and researchers can read this service's key from the workspace Key Vault. The Foundry browser playground, agents, tools, knowledge search, external URL fetches and file uploads remain outside the supported scope. That support limit is not an RBAC denial guarantee. The playground requires shared Azure management endpoints that the workspace firewall cannot restrict to this account.

See the [service documentation](https://microsoft.github.io/AzureTRE/latest/tre-templates/workspace-services/ai-foundry/).

is_exposed_externally.title: Expose externally
is_exposed_externally.description: Allow access from outside the workspace network. Authentication is still required. The private endpoint remains available.

local_auth_enabled.title: Enable API key authentication
local_auth_enabled.description: Allow API keys alongside Microsoft Entra ID. Owners and researchers can retrieve the key from Key Vault. Keys bypass per-user Entra role checks.

allowed_fqdns.title: Allowed outbound FQDNs
allowed_fqdns.description: Defaults to deny-all.invalid, a non-resolving hostname used to enforce outbound blocking. Removing the last entry or setting [] removes this workaround. Live tests on 25 September 2026 allowed external image and MCP requests with an empty list, despite outbound restriction remaining enabled. Real hostnames permit outbound access to those hosts. Enter exact hostnames, not URLs or wildcards.

openai_model.title: OpenAI model
openai_model.description: Select an approved OpenAI model. The service uses the Standard pricing tier. Azure TRE checks that the selected region offers this model and tier.

openai_model_capacity.title: Model capacity
openai_model_capacity.description: A token is a small unit of text that a model processes. Set the model capacity in thousands of tokens per minute.

workspace_owners_group_id.title: Workspace owners group ID
workspace_owners_group_id.description: Azure TRE copies the Microsoft Entra ID object ID for this group from the parent workspace. Azure TRE replaces any value entered here during installation.

workspace_researchers_group_id.title: Workspace researchers group ID
workspace_researchers_group_id.description: Azure TRE copies the Microsoft Entra ID object ID for this group from the parent workspace. Azure TRE replaces any value entered here during installation.
